name: werkbank-workspace
description: Your personal Werkbank settings and shared groups in Supabase: preferences sync, groups with roles, shared Spaces, configuration and team memory.

tools.name: get_preferences
tools.description: Load the saved personal Werkbank settings from the Supabase table werkbank.preferences.

tools.name: save_preferences
tools.description: Save the personal Werkbank settings (one row, settings only, no secrets) to werkbank.preferences.

tools.name: group_create
tools.description: Create a group; the actor becomes its admin. Write.

tools.name: group_list
tools.description: List the groups the actor belongs to, with role and revision. Read only.

tools.name: group_get
tools.description: Load one group: members, published Spaces (without their files), configuration and team memory. Read only.

tools.name: group_set_member
tools.description: Add a member or change a role (admin, member, viewer). Admin only. Write.

tools.name: group_remove_member
tools.description: Remove a member (an admin, or the person themself). Write.

tools.name: group_delete
tools.description: Delete a group with its Spaces and memory. Admin only. Irreversible: ask the person first.

tools.name: group_publish_space
tools.description: Publish a Space package (the file from "Share a Space") to the group; a new version replaces the old one. Admin or member. Write.

tools.name: group_get_space
tools.description: Load the package of one group Space. Read only.

tools.name: group_remove_space
tools.description: Remove a Space from the group (its publisher or an admin). Write.

tools.name: group_save_config
tools.description: Save the group configuration (shared instructions, starter prompts, profiles; no secrets). Admin only. Write.

tools.name: group_memory_add
tools.description: Add an entry to the team memory (fact, decision or rule, 1 to 600 characters). Admin or member. Write.

tools.name: group_memory_update
tools.description: Change a team memory entry (its author or an admin). Write.

tools.name: group_memory_delete
tools.description: Delete a team memory entry (its author or an admin). Ask the person first.

tools.name: save_work_item
tools.description: Write: save an agent, workflow or code (Python, JSON, Markdown) as a new revision with all its files in the shared database. Ask first.

tools.name: get_work_item
tools.description: Read one agent, workflow or code item with its files, current or earlier revision.

tools.name: list_work_items
tools.description: List the agents, workflows and code items the person may see.

tools.name: work_item_history
tools.description: The revisions of one item with author, note and time.

tools.name: archive_work_item
tools.description: Write: archive an item or bring it back. Owner, team admin or Governance board.

supabase_url.title: Supabase project URL
supabase_url.description: Optional. Example: https://<project-ref>.supabase.co. Leave empty to use the bundled sample data.

supabase_secret_key.title: Supabase secret key
supabase_secret_key.description: Optional. Server-side secret key (sb_secret_…) of that project. Stored as a secret, never written to config files.
